name: Prayers for the Fallen
source:
You are an Imperial Necromancer. A battered and broken Sentinel is brought before you. You are to examine it and determine whether or not it may still be of service to your Lord.

[From [url=https://xxmissarichanxx.itch.io/prayersforthefallen]itch.io[/url]]
